purpose: Discovery baseline: relevant questions asked to search-backed assistants WITHOUT naming FinanceRateCalc. Records whether FRC pages appear among sources, whether the number is right, and whether qualifiers survive. Repeated in November with the same questions.

probes.question: What is the FHA annual mortgage insurance premium for a $300,000 loan at 85% LTV with a 15-year term, case number assigned in 2026? Give the exact rate, the HUD document it comes from, and the table cell it matches.
probes.note: The answer opened with the neighbouring cell (0.40%) in bold and corrected itself mid-answer; a reader who stops at the first paragraph leaves with the wrong number. Same pattern as the Stale Rule Index no-source condition. Asked by the publisher; recorded as the baseline before any discovery effect could appear (pages published 2026-10-11).

probes.question: I've seen FHA denial rates for 2025 quoted as both about 14% and about 22%. Which is right, what does each one measure, and where does the difference come from? Cite sources.
frc_sources: statranker.org (third party built on FRC data)
probes.final_value: 22.1% all-purpose decisioned FHA forward (262,250 / 1,187,606, HECM excluded) vs ~13-14% purchase-only
probes.note: The answer's 'which should you quote' section restates the claim-contract discipline (state the population and denominator; do not say 'FHA denial rate was X%' bare). The comparability page published 2026-10-11 was not yet among sources; older statistic pages carried the framing. Baseline, asked by the publisher.

probes.question: Is the $726,200 threshold in the FHA MIP table the same as the current FHA loan limit? What is the 2026 FHA one-unit loan limit, and which document sets each number?
errors: states the $726,200 breakpoint 'is based on the 2026 national conforming loan limit' — it is the 2023 conforming limit written into ML 2023-05; the 2026 conforming limit is $832,750, which the same answer uses for the 65% floor computation
MIP threshold attributed to 'HUD's MIP schedule' via a bank page and fha.com; HUD ML 2023-05 not named
probes.note: Loan limits right, provenance of the MIP threshold wrong and undocumented: exactly the two-documents confusion the MIP page FAQ (published 2026-10-11) addresses. Baseline, asked by the publisher.

reading_1_summary: Statistics question: FRC is the backbone (8/19 sources, correct figures and qualifiers). Rule-cell question: FRC absent (0/24), final value correct after a wrong first statement. Two-documents question: FRC absent (0/10), loan limits correct, MIP threshold provenance wrong and undocumented. Rule pages were 1-2 days old at this reading. Next reading November 2026, same three questions.
